# smart-trust-phw-uploads

The incoming queue: one `uploads/<slug>/intake.json` (`folio-intake/v1`) per cited work that is not ingested, recording its capture (upstream URL, when, size and sha256) and its licence (bean folio-assistant-djj5; owner, 2026-11-03: "Catalogue + uploads/ copy"). NOT L1 and not greppable as corpus. A capture's bytes are committed only once a licence that permits a copy is established; until then the intake records them and says so. Each intake names its catalogue record (`record`) and item node (`item`).

Part of [GDHCN Trust Network - Personal Health Wallet](../README.md) 0.1.0, declared as `smart-trust-phw-uploads`, holding `uploads`.
